name: cable standing y raise v. 2
description: Raising the arms in a Y shape against cable tension works the lower traps and shoulders. It supports healthy overhead movement.
instructions: Stand facing the low cable with a handle in each hand or one handle at a time.
Start with your arms low and a slight bend in your elbows.
Lift your arms up and out to form a Y shape.
Keep your thumbs pointing up and your ribs down.
Lower slowly back to the start.
